summary: Iteration 5 tested window groups through the backend and UI (cloud target only). Backend: 12 of 12 new tests pass. They cover list and Main, create, rename and delete, a 404 after delete, the 400 refusal for group 1, the 409 at the 10-group limit, the 422 for an invalid group param, tab and navigation isolation, nav, input, switch and close, frame at quality=30, dialog and filechooser scoping, per-group recording, shared cookies (checked visually: httpbin /cookies in group 3 showed shadowtest=1 set in group 2), a target=_blank popup staying in the opening group, and parallel GPT runs in two groups. Both runs completed. A second run in the same group returned 409, runs/active was scoped per group, and closing a group with a live run returned 409. Light regression with test_shadow_api.py (no GPT runs): 17 of 17 pass. UI: the group bar, New group n/10, double-click rename, grid view with live tiles, tile click switching to single view, tile and chip pop-out (/?group=N&solo=1), group switching (URL bar, tabs and Activity follow the group), a command going to the selected group with a running status dot, Watch me scoped per group, the solo page (no side rail or group bar, solo-group-name, title 'Shadow · <name>') and close via the X button all work. Two real issues were found (see below). All TEST groups are closed, only Main remains, and no runs are active.

critical.issue: Group ids are reused after a restart because _n resets to 1, but runs that were active keep their old group_id. Startup turns them into 'paused' runs pointing at a group that no longer exists. Resume gives 404 ('This window group was closed'). When a new group later gets the same id, it inherits the stale run: the chip and tile show it, POST /runs in the new group returns 409, and DELETE of the group returns 409. Reproduced with tests/probe_stale_group_run.py by inserting a paused run for the next group id.

minor.issue: Returns 400 'This window group was closed' instead of 404, because group_close raises ValueError and the call maps it to 400.
A stopped or failed run whose group was closed cannot be resumed: it returns 404. Consider reopening a group, or falling back to the current or Main group.

ui_bugs.issue: After you switch away from a group and come back, its just-finished run is gone from the Activity panel, which shows 'No task yet'. switchGroup clears runId and pollActive only returns ACTIVE runs. A user who starts a task in group 2, watches group 1, then returns to group 2 never sees the result summary; it is only in History. Fix: remember the last runId per group, or have the backend return that group's latest run.

integration_issues.issue: notifyOther only fires for awaiting_approval and waiting_input. Background groups that complete or fail give no toast, so the user does not know group 3 finished while they are on group 1.

issues: The command bar stays active in grid view and sends to the last selected group, with nothing showing which group that is. Add 'to <group name>' to the placeholder or a chip, or disable it in grid view.
The red recording dot appears only after the next 2.5s groups poll. Call loadGroups after record start/stop.

action_items: Fix stale group runs after a restart. Options: mark runs whose group_id is not '1' as stopped or reassigned at startup; make group ids unique (e.g. a uuid or a persisted counter); or have create/close/active_run ignore runs whose group no longer exists in BrowserSession.groups.
Keep the last run per group in Workspace, or add GET /runs/latest?group=, so that coming back to a group still shows its finished run's summary.
Return 404 when closing an unknown group.
Optional: notify on completed or failed runs in other groups; show which group the command bar targets in grid view; refresh groups right after record start/stop.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has 980 lines. Split it into routers (browser/groups, runs, schedules).
groups_list builds by = {group_id: run}. If two active runs ever share a group id (e.g. stale runs), the last one wins silently.
Group metadata is only in memory, so after a restart users lose group names and tabs while their runs still reference group ids. This is the root cause of the critical issue.
The BrowserSession._on_page orphan adoption into group 1 after 1.5s is correct for target=_blank popups. Verified that the popup handler adopts first.

success_rate.backend: 100% of the 12 new tests and 17 regression tests (1 logic bug found by code review plus probe)
success_rate.frontend: ~90% (1 functional bug: finished run is lost after switching groups)

seed_data_creation: None kept. The probe inserted one TEST_ paused run doc and deleted it by id. TEST groups were all closed.

Group ids keep increasing within one backend process (ids 2 to 19 were used during this run), so do not hardcode ids. A 'Grants' group 2 was not present at the start, only Main.
